changes.summary: Switched to the public digest-pinned ARM64 image with matched sparse-MLA kernels, B12X GLM score mode, and the MTP indexer fix baked in.
Adopted upstream's 128K, four-sequence, MTP-k4 profile with FP8 DSA KV allocation, FULL CUDA graphs, GLM reasoning, and sparse-MLA controls.
Moved NCCL 2.30.4 into the adapter build using the exact PyPI ARM64 wheel and SHA-256 so serving requires no host-staged libraries or kernel mounts.
Added build-time fail-closed checks for every required kernel file and patch marker. Candidate status now denotes only the pending physical canary.
Aligned TP4 memory, sparse-MTP, batching, executor, CUDA graph, and NCCL settings while recording the missing upstream kernel bake.
Initial reviewed catalog release of GLM 5.2 QuantTrio four Sparks.
